monitor_name.description: Canonical name of the machine where scamper is run, used in warts output files.

list_name.description: Name of the list, used in warts output files.

list_id.description: Numerical ID of the list, used in warts output files.

cycle_id.description: Numerical cycle ID to begin with, used in warts output files.

default_command.description: Default command to use (trace, ping, host, dealias, neighbourdisc, sniff, sting, tbit, tracelb).

max_parallel_tasks.description: Maximum number of tasks probed in parallel. 0 means no upper limit.

output_file.description: Default output file path. Empty string means stdout.

output_format.description: Output format: text, warts, or json.

nameserver.description: Nameserver IP address to use. Empty for default /etc/resolv.conf.

debug_file.description: Filename to write debugging messages to. Empty to disable.

pid_file.description: File to write scamper's process ID to.

firewall.description: Firewall specification (ipfw:range or pf:anchor:num). Empty to disable firewall usage.

options.description: List of options to tailor behaviour (e.g., warts, text, planetlab, rawtcp, select, kqueue, epoll, noinitndc, outcopy, debugfileappend, notls, notls-remote). Items should be strings from the valid options list.

control_socket.description: Control socket listening address:port or unix domain socket path. Empty to disable daemon mode.

remote_controller.description: Remote host:port to connect to for receiving commands. Empty to disable remote control.

targets.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames to probe directly via -i flag.

target_file.description: Path to a file containing target addresses for the -f flag.

commands.description: List of complete commands (including targets) to execute via -I flag.
